label: Owner framework commitment: At the selected world w, every candidate individual with causal power…
paraphrase: Owner framework commitment: At the selected world w, (1) every candidate individual with causal power at w is concrete, and (2) every individual that causes anything at w is concrete. 'Concrete' has the adopted sense of #1103 (DEF-CONCRETE-ESSE-IN-RE: having esse in re), which is not defined through causal power; the Lean proposition takes the concreteness predicate as a parameter, and an intended instantiation supplies that sense. Power is a capacity that need not be exercised. The direct outgoing-causation clause is retained independently, not inferred through an assumed exercise-to-power interface. With abstract/concrete disjointness, these clauses exclude abstract powers and outgoing abstract causation. No materiality, spatial location, concrete-to-power converse, inability to be caused, existential coverage, or necessity is included.
note: Owner formulation, not a source claim or established metaphysical truth. The Lean declaration defines the two-clause proposition; it does not prove either clause. The concreteness sense was fixed by the owner on #1103 (2026-11-06): https://github.com/moritzbrantner/truth-core/issues/1103#issuecomment-6683616439. The proposition does not use exhaustiveness; for the adopted sense exhaustiveness is separately derived from excluded middle (CONCRETE-ABSTRACT-ESSE-DICHOTOMY). See docs/notes/causal-power-concreteness.md and docs/notes/concrete-abstract.md. No argument/result or root closure is registered.

disagreement.note: Also recorded: the SEP 'Abstract Objects' §3.2 participation problem (no account says what participation in an event makes an object a cause), an objection to the principle's application rather than a rival thesis. The exact selected-profile negative is now registered as a formal alternative. The original four full-strength accounts remain semantic objections; their productive/classification/world-selection interfaces are separate OPEN propositions, not implied by the disagreement roster. Owner approval is unchanged.

self_evident.note: Floor item (#1007 mechanism), approved by the owner on #1103 (2026-11-06) in its WEAK version: efficient/productive causes (Ontic.Causes) and bearers of causal power are concrete, in the adopted sense of having esse in re. The strong version STMT-CAUSAL-POWER-AND-ACTIVITY-REQUIRE-CONCRETENESS-STRONG (causes in every sense: formal, final, exemplar, explanatory; strengthens relation REL-CAUSAL-POWER-CONCRETENESS-STRONG-STRENGTHENS-WEAK) is not approved; it would conflict with exemplar causation on the Fourth Way route (STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-GENUS-CAUSES-ALL-IN-GENUS) and with Aristotelian formal and final causes. Justification: the owner asked for a derivation as well, and CAUSAL-POWER-CONCRETENESS-FROM-OPERARI derives this statement from operari sequitur esse (ST I q.75 a.2; q.25 a.1) and STMT-ACTUALITY-ONLY-INSOFAR-AS-BEING; its premises are still open, so the approval, not the derivation, is what establishes the item. Recorded rivals are stated at full strength and stay unrefuted.
